::: {.section-intro}
Learn the symbolic APIs, numerical modeling concepts, and inversion workflows
behind Devito and JUDI. Each track is made from executable notebooks and can be
followed in order or used as a reference.
:::

::: {.tutorial-track-grid}
::: {.tutorial-track-card .tutorial-track-primary}
<span class="track-number">01 · API foundations</span>

## Devito API

Start with symbolic mathematics, then learn equations, operators, subdomains,
boundary conditions, and conditional dimensions.

<p class="track-level">Best for · New Devito users</p>

[Start with symbolic mathematics](devitoapi/00_sympy.html)
:::

::: {.tutorial-track-card}
<span class="track-number">02 · Modeling series</span>

## Modeling and imaging

Build acoustic and elastic propagators, reverse-time migration, full-waveform
inversion, and advanced high-performance workflows.

<p class="track-level">Best for · Computational scientists</p>

[Start with seismic modeling](devitotutos/01_modelling.html)
:::

::: {.tutorial-track-card}
<span class="track-number">03 · JUDI series</span>

## JUDI workflows

Express modeling and inverse problems with matrix-free Julia operators,
optimization packages, constraints, and automatic differentiation.

<p class="track-level">Best for · Inverse-problem researchers</p>

[Start with JUDI](judituto/01_intro.html)
:::
:::
